message.content:
I don’t have a live weather tool available in this chat, so I can’t verify current conditions in Paris right now. Please check Météo-France, the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts, or a weather app for real-time data.

In general, Paris has a temperate oceanic climate: mild, damp winters; cool to warm summers; frequent light rain; and changeable skies year-round. If you tell me the date/season or what you need it for—travel, clothing, events—I can give more specific guidance.
